notes.title: When I update the game you will no longer get corrupt save files
notes.content: I think it's ideal to fix the save system this way now that the userbase has grown.

notes.title: Summary of patches
notes.content:
[h1]New areas [/h1]

Act 2 and City Hub.

[h1]Music and Sound[/h1]

Now the first two acts and the city hub have a coherent music theme. Balkan "video game" music.

Added footstep sounds.

[h1]Graphics[/h1]

Visible exp bar.
Fixed exp visuals.
Fixed item description visuals.
Remade some rooms from pixel art to high res paintings.

[h1]Combat, Inventory and Balance[/h1]

An update to combat. Chances are you'll miss sometimes if you button mash button "E". So make sure you're over your weapons energy. But you will no longer lose energy if you're under your weapons energy.

Items are saved after exiting game.
EXP and equipped equipment carries over to other rooms. Say you have "Daunting Whip" equipped, that means it will still be equipped when you move to another room.

XP carries over too. Just make sure to save your game to save your XP and level.

Damage shown is gone.

[h1]Balance[/h1]

Hammer energy per attack increased to 70 except for the beginner hammer.
Sword energy per attack reduced to 40.
Whip energy per attack reduced to 50.
When you attack with the whip, you enter an invulnerable state.

[h1]DLC Skins[/h1]

2 new player skins in the game, 1 for each playable character.

[h1]Miscellaneous[/h1]

Fixed issues with lag.
Added option to redo Act 1 and Act 2.

notes.title: Most Sold Units from launch until September 30th - Top 3 Regions
Several fixes
notes.content:
Reverted back to my own pathfinding after testing out a script made by someone. Result: My own pathfinding makes loading rooms lightning fast and I can save the game with the inventory, due to having enough memory.

Game won't crash anymore at first boss.

Added option from city hub to redo Act 1 and Act 2.

notes.content: Added the ability to teleport with the Ghostrider Sword.
